title: Package Download and Install Flow
interaction_flow: Caller → InstallationManager: execute(repo, operations[], devMode, runScripts, downloadOnly)
InstallationManager: split operations into batches (composer-plugin with plugin-modifies-downloads=true get own batch first)
loop [for each install/update operation in batch]
DownloadManager → FileDownloader: download(package, path, prevPackage): PromiseInterface
FileDownloader → HttpDownloader: addCopy(url, fileName, transportOptions): Promise
FileDownloader: collect response headers (GH Actions only)
InstallationManager: re-batch operations (composer-plugin/composer-installer each in own sub-batch)
InstallationManager → LibraryInstaller: prepare(type, package, prevPackage): Promise
LibraryInstaller → DownloadManager: prepare(type, package, downloadPath, prevPackage)
DownloadManager → FileDownloader: prepare(type, package, path): resolve(null)
FileDownloader: chmod binaries if executable missing
InstallationManager → LibraryInstaller: update(repo, initial, target): Promise
LibraryInstaller → DownloadManager: cleanup(type, package, downloadPath, prevPackage)
key_relationships: InstallationManager depends_on Loop (for async promise resolution)
InstallationManager depends_on EventDispatcher (for PRE/POST package events)
FileDownloader depends_on Cache (read/write dist archive cache)
FileDownloader depends_on Filesystem (ensureDirectoryExists, rename, unlink, emptyDirectory, removeDirectoryPhp)
FileDownloader depends_on EventDispatcher (PRE_FILE_DOWNLOAD, POST_FILE_DOWNLOAD plugin events)
FileDownloader stores static downloadMetadata[packageName] = fileSize (read by InstallationManager.notifyInstalls)
important_notes: Two-phase async execution: all downloads are fired as Promises (Phase 1), then Loop.wait() resolves them in parallel before Phase 2 (install/update/uninstall) begins
Batching strategy: composer-plugins with plugin-modifies-downloads=true are isolated in their own batch so they can intercept downloads of subsequent packages
Sub-batching in executeBatch: composer-plugin and composer-installer types each get own sub-batch to ensure activation order
FileDownloader uses vendor/composer/tmp-<md5>.ext as temporary file; renamed to final path on install
Cache check uses SHA1 checksum match; on hit resolves immediately without HTTP call
Retry logic in FileDownloader: 3 retries with 500ms sleep; fallback to next distUrl if all retries exhausted
Cleanup on SIGINT/SIGTERM: SignalHandler triggers runCleanup() which calls Loop.abortJobs() then all cleanup closures
downloadOnly=true exits after Phase 1 (downloads + cleanup only, no installation)
Static FileDownloader.$downloadMetadata used for packagist install notifications in notifyInstalls()
